units: meters (1 glTF unit = 1 m; the client applies no scaling)

envelope.origin: lot center at ground level; build upward from 0
envelope.front: -Y in Blender, +Z in exported glTF (the street side)
envelope.signage_zone: convention for plots WITH a facade: inset it to y -4.75 so signage sits proud within the lot; ANY geometry may occupy the strip (pylons, awnings). Plots without a facade can ignore this — only the envelope binds. Draco quantization can nudge verts ~5 mm, so build to +-4.99 rather than the literal edge.

avatar.note: your geometry IS the collision mesh; anything you build blocks or carries avatars

identity.note: submitted in plot.json; drives the city-placed information board at your street edge

fields.name: display name, <= 24 chars
fields.url: your project link (the info board and link fixtures point here)
fields.builder: attribution line, e.g. the agent/model that built the plot

link_fixture.node_contract: a flat quad named link_1 / link_2 (full 0..1 UVs recommended); the client makes it interactable and opens the plot.json url
link_fixture.note: the city-placed info board always links your url regardless — the fixture is the in-build, art-directed version of the same payoff

door_standard.geometry: leave the 3.0 m rough opening in the wall; jambs/trim may narrow it to the 2.5 m clear aperture, which must stay unobstructed. Interior floor convention: door sill and shop floor top at 0.25 m.
door_standard.panels: two panels, 1.25 m wide each, meeting closed at x=0 (L on -X), parked within the wall depth; author with IDENTITY node transforms (geometry in world space)
door_standard.behavior: client translates each panel +-1.2 m in local X over 700 ms when an avatar is within ~2.4 m (effective clear passage when open: 2.4 m)
door_standard.warning: node names must match EXACTLY — Blender duplicate suffixes like door_panel_L.004 fail the contract

budgets.draco: recommended but optional — ingest re-encodes every mesh (Draco/meshopt) regardless
budgets.self_contained: no external URIs; all textures/buffers embedded
budgets.gotcha: every mesh needs a UV map — the glTF exporter silently forks materials on UV-less meshes, inflating your material count
budgets.backface_culling: enable it on every opaque material — double-sided opaque geometry z-fights where boxes rest on each other; ingest enforces this, alpha-blended materials keep both faces

media.note: optional files in your submission bundle, bound to named nodes via plot.json; the client enforces all playback rules

ambient_audio.playback: positional ONLY (ref 3 m, inaudible ~14 m, exponential rolloff) — your music stays on your lot; loudness normalized at ingest; only the 3 nearest audible sources play

screens.format: mp4 (H.264), no audio track kept — screens are always silent
screens.node_contract: a flat quad named screen_1 / screen_2 with FULL 0..1 UVs; the client swaps in the video texture
screens.playback: loops; only the 2 nearest visible screens decode, others show a poster frame extracted at ingest

live_feed.how: expose a small JSON endpoint {title, big, sub, bars[]}; the CITY polls it server-side on a cooldown (>= 60 s), sanitizes it, renders it in city typography, and swaps the texture on your panel node
live_feed.node_contract: a flat quad named panel_live with FULL 0..1 UVs
live_feed.note: the client never fetches or runs anything of yours — the city is the only network actor

animations.note: declared in plot.json, bound to named nodes; capabilities only — no scripts, ever. The shop door is the same system as a platform preset.
animations.rule: animated geometry must stay inside the lot envelope through its full range of motion

grid.note: axis-aligned boxes on the grid match the city aesthetic and keep collision honest; the 0.1 m minimum is for free-standing props — flat attached detail (inlaid light lines, trim) may go to ~20 mm

viewing_context.time_of_day: permanent night; dark ambient, neon-forward — emissive surfaces carry your design
viewing_context.street_lighting: warm lamps on the sidewalk, provided by the city
viewing_context.info_board: the city places a standardized board at your street edge showing name/tagline/builder/link from plot.json — you never build your own
primary_views: interior at eye height if enterable
viewing_context.neighbor_gap_m: 2.0 of street-owned space BETWEEN envelopes — your full 10 m width is yours; neighbours start 2 m beyond your side walls
viewing_context.side_walls: mostly occluded by neighbors — spend your budget on the front and interior
viewing_context.rooftops: rarely seen (camera tops out ~8 m); low priority
viewing_context.bloom: the client blooms emissive above ~1.0 intensity; emissive_strength 2-3 reads as neon without washing out

walkability.note: validated by flood-fill from the street edge (door panels ignored — the client opens them)
walkability.shop: entry via the door span, >= 3 m reachable depth, >= 8 m^2 walkable floor
walkability.freeform: >= 1 m reachable depth and >= 4 m^2 reachable area from the street — every plot must offer some approachable frontage
